Topliner - Senior Fullstack Developer (Node.js / Laravel / React+TS / AI Integrations) - Remote - $80k/year https://topliner.app

We’re building Topliner, an AI-powered platform for executive search.

What you’ll work on: - Integrations with Loxo, Metaview, GetSales, Calendly - API design, background jobs, and sync pipelines - Auth flows, queue processing, caching - React+TS interfaces

Requirements: - 5+ years fullstack experience - Strong Node.js, Laravel/PHP, React+TS - API integrations, OAuth, async jobs - Understanding of scalable systems and data pipelines - Fluent English

Compensation: - $80k/year - Remote - Part-time → full-time path - Equity potential

Apply here >>> https://topliner.app/careers
